external_deps: Cloudflare Tunnel (optional, for remote chat monitor)

review.tagline: Installable agents, commands, hooks and MCP configs for Claude Code
review.summary: A catalog of Claude Code components (agents, slash commands, settings, hooks, MCP integrations and skills) installed per item with `npx claude-code-templates@latest` and browsable at aitmpl.com. It also ships npx-run tools: an analytics view for Claude Code sessions, a mobile-friendly conversation monitor with optional Cloudflare Tunnel access, a health check and a plugin dashboard.
review.audience: Claude Code users who want ready-made agents, hooks and MCP setups
strengths: One npx command installs a chosen agent, command, hook, setting, skill or MCP
Web catalog at aitmpl.com plus docs at docs.aitmpl.com
Includes analytics, health-check and conversation-monitor tools beyond the templates
MIT license; bundled third-party components keep their original licenses
weaknesses: Targets Claude Code only; no other coding assistant is mentioned
Many components come from third-party repos under mixed licenses (MIT, CC0, Apache 2.0)
README gives no per-component quality or review process; vetting is left to the user
Requires Node.js for npx; version requirements are unknown
needs: Needs Node.js/npx, Claude Code, Cloudflare Tunnel (optional, for remote chat monitor)
